Teacher & level author help

ADVENTURE MIDI files: ADVENTURE_1_Title.mid. Only tracks named CONTROL contain silent level commands (in ADVENTURE, a C0 note of MIDI 24 under Cubase/Nuendo's labeling sets chunk length). Live MIDI C1–C9 always sounds, including pitches outside the current exercise. A C0 command note is a silent chunk-length command: its note duration sets the number of beats per challenge and remains active until the next C0 or C#0 command. C#0 repeats adjacent marker durations as an irregular chunk pattern. D0 pulses toggle NESTED; a line longer than a bar selects CONTINUOUS until release. C1 pairs define a countdown and free-playing section. D#0–B0 set the level background gradient before play. Random mode remains the generated challenge. Metronome: optional short click (under 100ms), count-in and flashing beat number (piano header ♩ or Audio & MIDI gear). You can start answering on your first note; the beat follows you. Closer rhythm earns more points; 90% accuracy earns 100 points, with a +250 super bonus for immediate near-perfect responses. Chunk Length is measured in the MIDI file's beats (e.g. four sixteenth notes within one quarter-note beat). Chords at the same onset count together. In 4/4, sixteen beats equals four bars. CUMULATIVE revises from the beginning after each chunk. CONTINUOUS moves to the next chunk. NESTED teaches individual chunks, joins pairs, then joins larger phrases until the entire piece is learned. Play at the MIDI's original rhythm, with optional onset checking. Pause automatically after 10 seconds without player input. Files: SONG_1_title.mid, MELODY__4_title.mid, SCALE_9_title.mid, CHORD__23_title.mid. For automatic website scanning, add filenames to midi/manifest.json. Your browser can also open a local folder.
